invariants.rationale: The method always creates and returns a new HoodieWriteMetadata object.
The writeStatuses list is created and populated before being set on the result, so it should not be null at exit.
A List's size is always non-negative.
Input records are never checked for null, indicating the method expects a non-null argument.
The Option parameter is expected to be non-null; an absent value would be represented inside Option, not by null.
